links.outcome: Feasibility and correlation of AI-automated GLS and LVEF versus conventional analysis in local trastuzumab patients
links.effect: GLS correlation r=0.541 and LVEF r=0.895; AI success rate 14% for GLS and 51% for LVEF versus conventional methods; apical-three chamber view weakest (r=0.423).
links.quote: Compared to conventional methodology, AI-automated analysis has a significantly lower feasibility rate, demonstrating a success rate of 14% (GLS) and 51% (LVEF).

screen.reason: Evaluates feasibility, reproducibility, and agreement of an AI-based echocardiography quantification tool (GLS and LVEF) compared to conventional manual methods in a clinical service evaluation context, but does not test a specific deployment practice or guardrail.
